notes.title: Patch 2 - Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello! Hope you're all doing well!

Halloween is just around the corner, but the only thing scarier than a nasty trick is an even nastier bug! So this patch is just to fix one (very big!) bug around Landon not being deceitful being too much for the game to handle at one point ^^;

Thank you all for reporting bugs and crashes you encounter! I'm glad they don't seem to be hampering the experience too much! 

Happy Treating! :D

notes.title: Patch 1- Quality Of Life Improvements!
notes.content:
Hello! Not much has changed in this update, however, I did add in two features for if you're replaying a level you've already completed!

- You can skip seen cutscenes
- You are no longer required to listen to Pepo's tutorials if you've already played the level

I'm glad that you guys seem to be enjoying the game! Happy treating! :D
